description: This code-behind file handles user profile display and navigation control for the OnlineExamSystem web application, by retrieving user data from a SQL Server database based on session ID and managing page redirections.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile ASP.NET page, managing user data display and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves user info from database if user is logged in, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder method for profile button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to taken courses page.
